units.source_text: 老师总是以恩惠代替垂训。

en.t: The teacher always substituted favors for admonition.

units.source_text: 恰恰在应该垂训的时候，却对我施以恩惠。

en.t: At precisely the moment when he ought to have admonished me, he instead bestowed a favor on me.

units.source_text: 他这样做，大概不是偶然的吧。

en.t: That he did so was probably no accident.

units.source_text: 柏木来取钱的五天后，老师把我唤去，亲手交给我第一学期的学费3400元，以及走读车费350元、书籍文具费550元。

en.t: Five days after Kashiwagi came to collect the money, the teacher summoned me and personally handed me 3,400 yen for the first term's tuition, along with 350 yen for commuting expenses and 550 yen for books and stationery.

units.source_text: 按学校规定，学生必须在暑假前缴纳学费。

en.t: According to school regulations, students had to pay their tuition before the summer vacation.

units.source_text: 不过，自从发生那件事以后，我万万没想到老师还会给我这笔钱。

en.t: However, after that incident, I never imagined that the teacher would still give me this money.

units.source_text: 我本来以为老师既然知道我是不可信赖的，即使有心给我钱，也会把线直接汇给学校的吧。

en.t: I had thought that, since the teacher knew I could not be trusted, even if he meant to give me the money, he would transfer it directly to the school.
